The failure mode arises when possession switches occur without clear event triggers, leading to misclassification. This allows GSI to model phase transitions as stochastic processes, while GSE uses the same framework to simulate tactical evolution. The kernel of each phase is derived from event density and positional clustering, forming a basis for higher-order tactical inference.
